note: First election of the rural district council, polled 6 April 1899 with the county council and the boards of guardians; each district electoral division returned two councillors, who were also the guardians for the division. The Armagh city wards and Keady Urban elected guardians only and are not part of the rural district. Labels as printed in the Northern Whig ("Dillonite", "Healyite").
